comments.content: The new branch reads feature report 0x06 and unconditionally sets sensors_supported, rumble_supported, and powerstate_supported to true if the read succeeds. However, the existing Ultimate2 branch (above) only sets these flags based on the report contents. Reading a feature report successfully doesn't guarantee the device supports sensors/rumble/powerstate. Consider parsing the report to determine actual capabilities, or at least verify the report contents before enabling these features.

Adding 0x04 to the accepted report IDs means state packets with report ID 0x04 will now be parsed by the same code path as 0x01/0x03. Verify that the packet layout for report 0x04 matches the layout expected by HIDAPI_Driver8BitDo_HandleStatePacket (button/axis offsets), otherwise this could produce incorrect input readings.
Minor formatting: missing space after '||' before 'product_id == USB_PRODUCT_8BITDO_Pro_2'.
